title: LG’s humanoid robot arrives in 2027, running Nvidia’s Isaac GR00T
excerpt: LG will unveil a bipedal humanoid built on Nvidia's Jetson Thor and Isaac GR00T in early 2027, with an 80MW AI factory in South Korea to follow.
content_html:
LG will unveil a bipedal humanoid robot in the first quarter of 2027, built on Nvidia’s Jetson Thor processor, Isaac GR00T foundation model and Halos safety system. The two signed the agreement at Nvidia’s Santa Clara headquarters on 13 August.

LG will show a bipedal humanoid robot in the first quarter of next year. The company signed an agreement with Nvidia at its Santa Clara headquarters on 13 August, with LG Corp chairman Kwang Mo Koo and Jensen Huang both present.

Nvidia is supplying the thinking parts. The robot runs Jetson Thor for onboard processing and motion control, uses the Isaac GR00T foundation model, and carries Halos, which Nvidia describes as the first full-stack safety framework built for robots.

LG is supplying the body, and that is the argument for why an appliance company belongs in this race. Actuators and sensors come from LG Electronics and LG Innotek, batteries from LG Energy Solution, so most of the bill of materials stays inside the group.

Something arrives before the humanoid does. LG will put CLOiD, its wheel-based robot, onto the production line at its washing machine plant in Tennessee by the end of 2026, feeding results into a data operation built on LG CNS’s PhysicalWorks platform that generates synthetic training sets alongside real ones.

The compute comes after. An AI factory reference site on Nvidia’s Vera Rubin platform is due in the first half of 2027, followed by an 80 megawatt facility at Cheonan in South Korea by the first half of 2028, with Nvidia’s DRIVE Hyperion platform going into LG’s vehicle work.

None of this makes LG special to Nvidia, which is the point. Nvidia is not backing a winner in humanoids, it is selling the same stack to every contender, and has already signed up Japan’s robotics establishment for its open world models.

It has been widening the roster deliberately. Nvidia has been courting manufacturers beyond China’s Unitree, which has been outselling Tesla on humanoids.

LG is not even alone at home. Samsung has set up a CEO-led robotics division chasing the same market, and Hyundai owns Boston Dynamics.

The safety layer is the part worth watching. Humanoids sharing floor space with people is the liability question the industry has never answered, and Huang framed the whole partnership around it, calling the opportunity of physical AI giving every machine the ability to “understand the real world, reason and act safely.”

Everything else here is dated 2027 or 2028. The only machine going to work this year is a robot on wheels in Tennessee.

content_html_zh:
LG 将于 2027 年第一季度推出一款双足人形机器人，该机器人基于 Nvidia 的 Jetson Thor 处理器、Isaac GR00T 基础模型和 Halos 安全系统构建。 两人于 8 月 13 日在英伟达圣克拉拉总部签署了协议。

LG将于明年第一季度展示一款双足人形机器人。 该公司于 8 月 13 日在圣克拉拉总部与 Nvidia 签署了协议，LG 公司董事长 Kwang Mo Koo 和 Jensen Huang 均出席。

Nvidia 正在提供思考部件。 该机器人运行 Jetson Thor 进行机载处理和运动控制，使用 Isaac GR00T 基础模型，并搭载 Halos，Nvidia 将其描述为第一个为机器人构建的全栈安全框架。

LG 提供了机身，这就是家电公司参与这场竞赛的理由。 执行器和传感器来自 LG Electronics 和 LG Innotek，电池来自 LG Energy Solution，因此大部分物料清单都留在集团内部。

有东西先于人形生物到达。 LG 将在 2026 年底前将其轮式机器人 CLOiD 投入田纳西州洗衣机工厂的生产线，将结果输入到基于 LG CNS 的 PhysicalWorks 平台构建的数据操作中，该平台可生成合成训练集和真实训练集。

计算紧随其后。 Nvidia Vera Rubin 平台上的人工智能工厂参考站点预计将于 2027 年上半年建成，随后将于 2028 年上半年在韩国天安建成一座 80 兆瓦的工厂，Nvidia 的 DRIVE Hyperion 平台将用于 LG 的汽车生产。

所有这些都没有使 LG 对于 Nvidia 来说有何特别，但这才是重点。 英伟达并不支持类人机器人领域的获胜者，而是向每个竞争者出售相同的堆栈，并且已经与日本机器人公司签署了其开放世界模型的协议。

它一直在刻意扩大名单。 英伟达一直在向中国 Unitree 以外的制造商示好，Unitree 在人形机器人方面的销量已经超过了特斯拉。

LG 在家中并不孤单。 三星成立了一个由首席执行官领导的机器人部门来追逐同一市场，而现代则拥有波士顿动力公司。

安全层是值得关注的部分。 类人机器人与人共享地面空间是业界从未回答过的责任问题，黄围绕这一问题构建了整个合作伙伴关系，称物理人工智能的机会使每台机器都有能力“理解现实世界、推理并安全行动”。

这里的其他所有内容的日期都是 2027 年或 2028 年。 今年唯一投入使用的机器是田纳西州的一个带轮子的机器人。
